description: Turn a list of guardrail rules into a policy document and a test module, and check examples against it. When codifying content or safety rules for an agent. Do not choose this when you need a live moderation model, which needs a model call. Example requests: Build a guardrail policy from these rules. | Generate a policy config and tests for these rules. | Check these examples against my guardrails.

accepted_price.description: The quoted amount, echoed exactly; checked against the quote.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

buyer_token.description: The buyer_token returned with your first purchase. It opens the purchase history for that buyer, including earlier deliverables.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key; the same key returns the same job.

examples.description: The customer's examples.txt, as text. Supported: Plain text. Example strings, one per line. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

rules.description: The customer's rules.txt, as text. Supported: Plain text. One 'name=regex' rule per line. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

payment_signature.description: x402 payment payload; required for a priced capability (see submit_job).

quote_id.description: The quote_id from POST /v1/jobs; required when priced.

name: submit_guardrail_policy_config
title: Guardrail policy config
